title: Progressive MCP authorization

story.need: authorize the least privilege required by each requested CMS operation
story.outcome: read, draft, and publish operations work without silently over-privileging the client

scope: Map every MCP tool call to its required OAuth scope at the HTTP authorization boundary
Challenge insufficiently scoped clients so interactive OAuth can elevate consent
Preserve tool-level scope checks as defense in depth
dataRequirements: OAuth consent records the granted scope set
Access tokens carry the granted scopes

then: the HTTP boundary returns an insufficient-scope challenge for cms:content:write
the client can complete interactive OAuth and retry
read permission is not substituted for publish permission

verification: Claude Desktop write and publish test
